description: List the 12 identity archetypes, each with its name, what it describes and its protective equation. Use this before you read an archetype off any other call, so the label means something to you rather than being passed through as an opaque string. Returns the taxonomy itself, static reference data that is the same for every caller; no member is named and no member's archetype is returned here. Takes no parameters. Free L0, no authentication required.
name: list_archetypes
title: List Identity Archetypes
